title: Early Morning Sunwatch
text:
🌅 Early Morning Sunwatch — November 22, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.8​)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B4.7 (Peaked November 21, 2026 at 19:27 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 384 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.33)

Calm conditions right now. 🖤🌎

A broad dark coronal-hole region and several bright active regions are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no clearly distinctive large outward structure.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 193 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
